info.prompt: Orthographic aerial shot of a gothic neural network: 20 bio-mechanical modules humming with synaptic pathways in #c8d400 chartreuse across a mathematical grid, Horror and Roguelike nodes looming as obsidian monoliths with intricate circuit-board tracery. Faint ASCII symbols flicker like stained glass in the negative space, while a 140 BPM LFO throb distorts the perspective slightly with each pulse. Tier indicators glow like chalice flames at each node’s base, their light casting long shadows across the grid’s precise coordinates.
